title: OnboardingPlaybook
description: One playbook per asset type - the same rule intake forms already follow, so creation-time enforcement has exactly one answer. Variation inside an asset type is handled by conditions on individual checks, not by competing playbooks.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this playbook.

entityType.description: The asset type this playbook governs. Only one playbook may exist per asset type.

onboarding.description: The lifecycle and gates this playbook enforces.

intakeForm.description: Intake form migrated into this playbook's Creation gate. Retained so the legacy read path keeps resolving.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this entity.

owners.description: Owners of this playbook - shown as `maintained by`.

changeDescription.description: Change that led to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Change that led to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.

targetEntityType.description: Asset types that support an onboarding playbook today.
